findings.finding: Food-focused and D16 PASS could be recorded from caller-supplied integer exit codes without machine-generated execution evidence.
findings.required_fix: Run the exact commands directly or validate exact-subject machine-generated per-command receipts with command and log hashes.

findings.finding: Run A and B did not require distinct receipt, canonical-result, result-root, and execution identities, so one receipt could be supplied twice.
findings.required_fix: Enforce two direct runs with distinct sealed work/result roots and distinct receipt/canonical paths.

findings.finding: Repository-only validation rechecked only a subset of recorded invariants and could accept internally fabricated PASS JSON.
findings.required_fix: Recompute and compare the complete canonical focused, clean-checkout, correction-review, authority, command, subject, and current-route structures.

findings.finding: The canonical owner-ratification path and expected authority/reviewer schema, role, identity, participation, and binding predicates were not sufficiently fixed.
findings.required_fix: Fix the ratification path and hash and validate exact review schema, role, non-participation flags, terminal credit, reviewed subject, and reviewed blob/hash bindings.

findings.location: implementation plan Appendix B and unchanged closeout final-manifest construction
